question.uz: “5” soni inglizcha qanday aytiladi?
question.ru: Как по-английски будет число «5»?
question.en: Which word means the number 5?

explanation.uz: 5 — “five”. “Fifteen” — 15, “fifty” — 50, “four” esa 4.
explanation.ru: 5 — это five. Fifteen — 15, fifty — 50, а four — 4.
explanation.en: 5 is five. Fifteen is 15, fifty is 50 and four is 4.

question.uz: Biz nima bilan ko‘ramiz? Inglizcha so‘zni tanlang.
question.ru: Чем мы видим? Выберите английское слово.
question.en: What do we see with?

explanation.uz: Biz ko‘zlarimiz bilan ko‘ramiz, inglizchada ko‘zlar — “eyes”. “Ears” — quloqlar, “nose” — burun, “hands” — qo‘llar.
explanation.ru: Мы видим глазами, а «глаза» по-английски — eyes. Ears — уши, nose — нос, hands — руки.
explanation.en: We see with our eyes. We hear with our ears, smell with our nose and hold things with our hands.

question.uz: Qaysi inglizcha so‘z mevani bildiradi?
question.ru: Какое английское слово обозначает фрукт?
question.en: Which word is a fruit?

explanation.uz: “Apple” — olma, u meva. “Chair” — stul, “dog” — it, “pen” — ruchka.
explanation.ru: Apple — «яблоко», это фрукт. Chair — стул, dog — собака, pen — ручка.
explanation.en: An apple is a fruit. A chair is furniture, a dog is an animal and a pen is for writing.

question.uz: Inglizchada “Monday”dan keyin qaysi kun keladi?
question.ru: Какой день недели идёт после Monday?
question.en: Which day comes after Monday?

explanation.uz: Hafta kunlari tartibi: Monday (dushanba), Tuesday (seshanba), Wednesday (chorshanba) va hokazo.
explanation.ru: Порядок дней недели: Monday (понедельник), Tuesday (вторник), Wednesday (среда) и так далее.
explanation.en: The days go in this order: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

question.uz: Ertalab salomlashganda inglizcha nima deymiz?
question.ru: Что мы говорим по-английски, когда здороваемся утром?
question.en: What do we say when we greet someone in the morning?

explanation.uz: Ertalab “Good morning” deymiz. “Good night” uxlashdan oldin, “Goodbye” esa xayrlashganda aytiladi.
explanation.ru: Утром говорят Good morning. Good night говорят перед сном, а Goodbye — при прощании.
explanation.en: In the morning we say Good morning. Good night is for bedtime, and Goodbye is for leaving.

question.uz: Yilning eng sovuq fasli inglizcha qanday ataladi?
question.ru: Как по-английски называется самое холодное время года?
question.en: Which is the coldest season of the year?

explanation.uz: Eng sovuq fasl — qish, inglizchada “winter”. “Summer” — yoz, “spring” — bahor, “autumn” — kuz.
explanation.ru: Самое холодное время года — зима, по-английски winter. Summer — лето, spring — весна, autumn — осень.
explanation.en: Winter is the coldest season. Summer is the hottest, and spring and autumn are in between.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: We write with a ___.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: We write with a ___.
question.en: Fill in the blank: We write with a ___.

explanation.uz: “Pen” — ruchka, u bilan yozamiz. “Bag” — sumka, “desk” — parta, “door” — eshik.
explanation.ru: Pen — «ручка», ею пишут. Bag — сумка, desk — парта, door — дверь.
explanation.en: We write with a pen. A bag carries books, a desk is for sitting at and a door opens and closes.

question.uz: Onangizning onasi inglizcha qanday ataladi?
question.ru: Как по-английски называют маму вашей мамы?
question.en: What do you call your mother’s mother?

explanation.uz: Onaning onasi — buvi, inglizchada “grandmother”. “Sister” — opa yoki singil, “aunt” — xola yoki amma, “daughter” — qiz farzand.
explanation.ru: Мама мамы — бабушка, по-английски grandmother. Sister — сестра, aunt — тётя, daughter — дочь.
explanation.en: Your mother’s mother is your grandmother. An aunt is your parent’s sister, and a daughter is someone’s child.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: She ___ a red bag.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: She ___ a red bag.
question.en: Fill in the blank: She ___ a red bag.

explanation.uz: He, she, it bilan “has” ishlatiladi: she has. I, you, we, they bilan esa “have” keladi.
explanation.ru: С he, she, it используется has: she has. С I, you, we, they — have.
explanation.en: We use has with he, she and it: she has. We use have with I, you, we and they.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: ___ are my books.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: ___ are my books.
question.en: Fill in the blank: ___ are my books.

explanation.uz: “Books” ko‘plikda, shuning uchun “these” kerak: these are. “This” birlik uchun ishlatiladi: this is.
explanation.ru: Books — множественное число, поэтому нужно these: these are. This — для единственного числа: this is.
explanation.en: Books is plural, so we need these: these are. This is for one thing: this is.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: one mouse, two ___
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: one mouse, two ___
question.en: Fill in the blank: one mouse, two ___

explanation.uz: “Mouse” (sichqon) qoidaga bo‘ysunmaydigan ot: uning ko‘plik shakli “mice”.
explanation.ru: Mouse («мышь») — исключение: во множественном числе mice.
explanation.en: Mouse is an irregular noun: its plural is mice.

question.uz: Qaysi inglizcha so‘z to‘g‘ri yozilgan?
question.ru: Какое английское слово написано правильно?
question.en: Which word is spelled correctly?

explanation.uz: “School” (maktab) s-c-h-o-o-l harflari bilan yoziladi; bu so‘zda “ch” [k] deb o‘qiladi.
explanation.ru: School («школа») пишется s-c-h-o-o-l; сочетание ch здесь читается как [k].
explanation.en: School is spelled s-c-h-o-o-l; here the letters ch sound like k.

question.uz: Savolga mos javobni tanlang: How old are you?
question.ru: Выберите подходящий ответ на вопрос: How old are you?
question.en: Choose the right answer to the question: How old are you?

explanation.uz: “How old are you?” — “Necha yoshdasan?” degani, shuning uchun yoshimizni aytamiz: I am nine.
explanation.ru: How old are you? значит «Сколько тебе лет?», поэтому называем возраст: I am nine.
explanation.en: How old are you? asks about age, so we answer with how many years old we are: I am nine.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: I am ___ a book now.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: I am ___ a book now.
question.en: Fill in the blank: I am ___ a book now.

explanation.uz: “Am” va “now” ish-harakat ayni paytda bo‘layotganini bildiradi, shuning uchun fe’lga -ing qo‘shiladi: I am reading.
explanation.ru: Am и now показывают, что действие происходит сейчас, поэтому к глаголу добавляется -ing: I am reading.
explanation.en: Am and now show the action is happening at the moment, so the verb takes -ing: I am reading.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: While I ___ dinner, the lights went out.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: While I ___ dinner, the lights went out.
question.en: Fill in the blank: While I ___ dinner, the lights went out.

explanation.uz: Boshqa voqea yuz bergan paytda davom etayotgan o‘tmishdagi harakat Past Continuous bilan ifodalanadi: was cooking.
explanation.ru: Действие, которое длилось в прошлом в момент другого события, выражается Past Continuous: was cooking.
explanation.en: An action in progress in the past when something else happened takes the Past Continuous: was cooking.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: You ___ wear a seat belt in a car. It is the law.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: You ___ wear a seat belt in a car. It is the law.
question.en: Fill in the blank: You ___ wear a seat belt in a car. It is the law.

explanation.uz: “It is the law” qat’iy majburiyatni bildiradi, qat’iy majburiyat esa “must” bilan ifodalanadi.
explanation.ru: It is the law указывает на строгую обязанность, а строгую обязанность выражает must.
explanation.en: It is the law shows a strict obligation, and strict obligation is expressed with must.

question.uz: “enormous” so‘zining sinonimini tanlang.
question.ru: Выберите синоним к слову “enormous”.
question.en: Choose a synonym for “enormous”.

explanation.uz: “Enormous” va “huge” ikkalasi ham “juda katta, ulkan” ma’nosini bildiradi; “tiny” esa aksincha, “juda kichik” degani.
explanation.ru: Enormous и huge оба значат «огромный»; tiny — наоборот, «крошечный».
explanation.en: Enormous and huge both mean very big; tiny means the opposite.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: If I ___ rich, I would travel around the world.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: If I ___ rich, I would travel around the world.
question.en: Fill in the blank: If I ___ rich, I would travel around the world.

explanation.uz: Ikkinchi tur shart gapda (hozirgi xayoliy holat) if qismida Past Simple keladi, “to be” esa odatda “were” shaklida bo‘ladi: If I were.
explanation.ru: В условных предложениях второго типа (нереальное настоящее) после if ставится Past Simple, а to be обычно имеет форму were: If I were.
explanation.en: The second conditional (an unreal present) uses the Past Simple after if, and to be usually becomes were: If I were.

question.uz: O‘zlashtirma gapga aylantiring: “Where do you live?” she asked. → She asked me where ___.
question.ru: Переведите в косвенную речь: “Where do you live?” she asked. → She asked me where ___.
question.en: Change to reported speech: “Where do you live?” she asked. → She asked me where ___.

explanation.uz: O‘zlashtirma so‘roq gapda so‘z tartibi darak gapdagidek bo‘ladi (do/did ishlatilmaydi), zamon esa bir pog‘ona orqaga suriladi: where I lived.
explanation.ru: В косвенном вопросе используется прямой порядок слов (без do/did), а время сдвигается в прошлое: where I lived.
explanation.en: Reported questions use statement word order (no do/did), and the tense moves back: where I lived.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: A new bridge ___ here next year.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: A new bridge ___ here next year.
question.en: Fill in the blank: A new bridge ___ here next year.

explanation.uz: Ko‘prik o‘zini o‘zi qurmaydi, uni quradilar, shuning uchun kelasi zamon majhul nisbati kerak: will be + V3 (will be built).
explanation.ru: Мост не строит сам себя — его построят, поэтому нужен страдательный залог в будущем времени: will be + V3 (will be built).
explanation.en: The bridge does not build itself, so we need the future passive: will be + V3 (will be built).

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: I need to ___ this word in the dictionary.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: I need to ___ this word in the dictionary.
question.en: Fill in the blank: I need to ___ this word in the dictionary.

explanation.uz: “Look up” — lug‘at yoki ma’lumotnomadan qidirib topmoq. “Look after” — g‘amxo‘rlik qilmoq, “give up” — voz kechmoq, “turn down” — rad etmoq.
explanation.ru: Look up — «найти в словаре или справочнике». Look after — заботиться, give up — бросить, сдаться, turn down — отклонить.
explanation.en: Look up means find information in a dictionary or reference book. Look after means take care of, give up means stop trying, turn down means refuse.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: If she had studied harder, she ___ the exam.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: If she had studied harder, she ___ the exam.
question.en: Fill in the blank: If she had studied harder, she ___ the exam.

explanation.uz: Uchinchi tur shart gap o‘tmishdagi ro‘y bermagan holatni bildiradi: If + had + V3, … would have + V3.
explanation.ru: Условное предложение третьего типа описывает нереальное прошлое: If + had + V3, … would have + V3.
explanation.en: The third conditional talks about an unreal past: If + had + V3, … would have + V3.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: Never ___ such a beautiful sunset.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: Never ___ such a beautiful sunset.
question.en: Fill in the blank: Never ___ such a beautiful sunset.

explanation.uz: “Never” kabi inkor so‘z gap boshida kelsa, inversiya bo‘ladi: yordamchi fe’l egadan oldin keladi — Never have I seen.
explanation.ru: Если отрицательное слово never стоит в начале предложения, происходит инверсия: вспомогательный глагол ставится перед подлежащим — Never have I seen.
explanation.en: When a negative word like never starts the sentence, we use inversion: the auxiliary comes before the subject — Never have I seen.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: She lives on a farm, so she is used to ___ up early.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: She lives on a farm, so she is used to ___ up early.
question.en: Fill in the blank: She lives on a farm, so she is used to ___ up early.

explanation.uz: “Be used to” (biror narsaga o‘rganib qolmoq) iborasidagi “to” — predlog, shuning uchun undan keyin fe’l -ing shaklida keladi: is used to getting up.
explanation.ru: В выражении be used to («привыкнуть к чему-либо») to — предлог, поэтому после него глагол стоит в форме -ing: is used to getting up.
explanation.en: In be used to (be accustomed to), to is a preposition, so the verb after it takes the -ing form: is used to getting up.
